cs.t:
Soda water, I am addicted to it.
-Got a SodaStream and immediately decided I couldn't continue paying that much for refills. Bought a 5lb adapter hose on Ebay and a tank. One use paid off the CAPEX. Recommend strongly.
-Got a Stanley Growler for bringing it around. It is indestructible. I bring it into the mine every day and it has held up like a serious champ despite the abuse. Probably going to buy a second. Other than that my Ikea standing desk and tall-fit shirts probably take the cake for me!
cs.th: Ask HN: Favorite purchases of last two years?
